description: Mobile (iPhone, Sprint carrier) screenshot of a tweet by attorney Victoria Toensing (@VicToensing), shown as retweeted by Sara A. Carter. Toensing criticizes the Justice Department, claiming U.S. Attorney John Huber, appointed nine months earlier to look into Uranium One and an allegedly false FISA application, had not interviewed the Ohrs or her client Doug Campbell, whom she describes as the FBI undercover informant for Uranium One. Dated 8/31/18.
text: Sprint. 11:33 AM. 72%. Tweet. Sara A. Carter Retweeted. Victoria Toensing @VicToensing. Shame on @TheJusticeDept. AG appointed @USAttyHuber 9 months ago to look into #UraniumOne and #FISA false application. Huber has not interviewed Ohrs. Huber has not interviewed my client Doug Campbell, the FBI undercover informant for Uranium One. #maga. 8/31/18, 7:08 AM. 1,850 Retweets 3,341 Likes. Tweet your reply
flags: Tweet's assertions about the Huber investigation and Campbell's informant role are the author's claims, not verified facts
